title: MV Map made with YED_Tiled Works only on Play Test.

posts.author: Fr4ncioh
posts.body:
Hi, I’m using RPG Maker MV with the YED_Tiled plugin and I have a problem with one specific map. The issue only happens after exporting the game. In playtest everything works fine with no errors in the debug console.
I usually work with many plugins and events but to test this I disabled them all. With no plugins and no events everything works fine.
Then I tested again with only YED_Tiled enabled. The game gets stuck on "Now Loading" forever when entering that map. Other maps load without problems.
In playtest that map loads fine with no errors.
After exporting only that map gets stuck on "Now Loading" forever.
This happens only with that one map.
Any idea what could be causing it?
Thanks in advance.
